page.layout: One printed page on the scan: a bookplate (armorial ex libris) of Johann Wilhelm Montagu, Earl of Sandwich, centred on a white leaf, with a coat of arms above; two lines of printed text below the arms. A second, separate printed label (ex libris of John Sinkankas) sits at the upper right, overlapping the board. Handwritten pencil and ink notes at upper left are not transcribed.
page.notes: The engraved coat of arms shows a merman (Neptune-like figure with trident and crown) at left, an eagle at right, a crest of a griffin-like bird above a crown, and the motto "POST TOT NAUFRAGIA PORTUM" on the scroll. The motto is partly obscured: the visible words are POST TOT, NAUFRAGIA, PORTUM. The printed label at upper right reads: "EX LIBRIS JOHN SINKANKAS" with the border text "Gemstones of North America · Prospecting for Gem Stones and Minerals · Gems & Gem Cutting · Emerald and Other Beryls Catalog · Mineralogy"; it is a modern bookplate and is not transcribed as main text. Handwritten pencil "28.50 1965 Gardner" and red pencil marks are excluded as handwriting.
